# Sitch (matchmaking app)

}}
Sitch is a matchmaking application that uses artificial intelligence (AI) and human oversight to connect individuals seeking relationships. The app was launched in 2024 and is operated by Sitch Inc., headquartered in New York City, United States.
History
Sitch was co-founded by Nandini Mullaji and Chad DePue. Mullaji’s family has a background in traditional matchmaking, which influenced the app’s development. The company raised seed funding led by venture firm M13 and received additional investment through Andreessen Horowitz’s Speedrun accelerator program and individual angel investors.
Features
Sitch requires new users to complete a detailed questionnaire to generate individual profiles. Matches are generated through a combination of large language model technology and human review.
The onboarding process includes a voice interface that uses voice cloning software based on Mullaji’s recordings. New user profiles are manually reviewed before approval. Users receive a limited number of introductions per week and can provide feedback after interactions.
Business model
The service operates on a pay-per-match basis. Users purchase a package of introductions in advance. Refunds may be offered in specific cases, such as when a match does not respond.
Availability
As of 2025, Sitch operates primarily in New York City and San Francisco, with plans to expand to other major cities in the United States.
